simple.summary: אֶרֶךְ (ʼErek) means Erek , a place in Babylon First listed occurrence: Gen 10 10.

definitions.full: H751. Erek אֶ֫רֶךְ proper name, of a location city in Babylonia (Babylonian Urûk see Dl below) on left bank of Euphrates,approximately 40 miles northwest from Ur ( אוּר ) toward Babylon; modern Warka ; compare Loftus CS 152 f. Dl Pa 221 f .
